text.p: Seamico Securities said on Tuesday it has rated Thai telecommunication conglomerate, Shinawatra Computer and Communications Plc, as a "buy", saying its shares are underpriced.
"SHIN's fair value is 384 baht ($15.36) per share. We think that the stock is attractive below 400 baht," Seamico said in a research report.
At the midday break, Shinawatra was up six baht to 384 baht.
In the first nine months of this year, Shinawatra posted a net profit of 2.41 billion baht against 2.63 billion baht in the same period last year.
Seamico said the fall in profit was due to a lack of any realised capital gains in the period.
The slower number of new mobile phone subscribers also caused a decline in its sales revenue, Seamico said. ($1.00=25 baht)
